job_description:
Product Manager

We need a product manager to own a consumer product area. You will manage the roadmap, write requirements, and work cross-functionally to ship features.

Requirements:
- 3+ years in product management
- Roadmap and prioritization experience
- Strong requirements writing and communication
- Comfortable with stakeholder management
notes: Second product-management fixture: a consumer-product PM match (vs. the senior enterprise/B2B case), broadening discipline coverage. Solid roadmap/requirements resume aligned to a consumer PM JD.
